headline: REGGIE ALLEGEDLY SOLD HIS CLOVER BOYS CHAIN Reggie has allegedly sold his Clover Boys pend
body: REGGIE ALLEGEDLY SOLD HIS CLOVER BOYS CHAIN Reggie has allegedly sold his Clover Boys pendant and chain that he was gifted by KaiCenat during the Mafiathon 3 stream last year.. The piece wasn’t just another chain — it was a gift connected to the Clover Boys and a memorable moment from Mafiathon He put the caption “thank you god ” — showcasing he is grateful to “move on from the past” Do yall really think he sold it?
